cards.need: A mining crew is trapped in a collapsing fissure, and we can't map a safe drill path without a drone that can squeeze through the wreckage.
cards.stakes: The air recyclers in the pocket will fail in six hours, and twelve miners will suffocate.
cards.board_text: I need a Piloted Survey Drone dropped here yesterday! We've got twelve people stuck under half a mountain of rock, and the primary sensors are blind. I can't risk a drill blindly without mapping the faults. Get me eyes down there, or I'm ordering body bags.

cards.need: I dropped my lucky wrench down a ventilation shaft and my arms are too thick to reach it.
cards.stakes: I refuse to start the refinery cycle without it, and my crew is threatening a mutiny over the delay.
cards.board_text: Don't ask questions, just bring me a survey drone. The small kind. I lost my favorite wrench down a tube and I am not putting my hand in there, it smells weird. The boys say I'm holding up production, but I ain't turning the melter on without my lucky wrench.

cards.need: My daughter's scout ship was lost in this sector, and I want to search the debris field myself.
cards.stakes: Without closure, I can never move on from her disappearance.
cards.board_text: The authorities say they've called off the search, but I know she's still out there. I just need a survey drone to comb the outer asteroid belt. I can't leave her behind in the dark. Please help me bring my little girl home, one way or another.

cards.need: The core contains the cure formula for the plague sweeping our lower decks.
cards.stakes: If I don't get those synthesis instructions, the mortality rate will reach one hundred percent by tomorrow.
cards.board_text: This is an emergency medical requisition. I am tracking a courier who went down with an encrypted core carrying the cure sequence for this blight. Bring it to me immediately. Every minute you waste, someone's lungs turn to ash.

cards.need: This core contains the unedited financial records that prove I was framed for embezzlement.
cards.stakes: Without this evidence, I will spend the rest of my life in a penal colony for a crime my boss committed.
cards.board_text: I lost everything when they pinned the missing funds on me. That core has the real transaction logs. If you can get it to me before my sentencing hearing, I can finally clear my name and look my family in the eye again. Please, it's my last chance.

cards.need: The annual station flower show is next month and my rival has imported rare orchids.
cards.stakes: I will lose my title as 'Best in Show' and be forced to endure a year of smug gloating.
cards.board_text: That arrogant fool thinks he can beat my hydrangeas? Unacceptable! I need a seed vault of exotic, hyper-blooming flora, and I need it fast. I will not let some amateur with a fancy greenhouse steal my ribbon. The honor of my garden is at stake!

cards.need: I promised my late husband I would plant his favorite trees on our new homeworld.
cards.stakes: I'm getting too old to travel, and this is my last chance to fulfill his dying wish.
cards.board_text: My bones ache, and I don't have many jumps left in me. I need a seed vault with old-strain maples. My husband always dreamed of seeing red leaves in the autumn here. Just bring me the seeds, so I can rest knowing I kept my promise.

cards.need: This tube holds the chemical samples proving the local syndicate is poisoning the water supply.
cards.stakes: If the magistrate doesn't see this today, the cartel's assassins will find me and the poisoning will continue.
cards.board_text: They know I took the samples. I can hear them in the corridor. I need someone to get this sealed evidence tube to the central magistrate right away. Don't open it, don't stop, just run. If this doesn't arrive, a lot of people are going to die, starting with me.

cards.need: Our navigator refuses to plot the jump through the chaotic storm sector without the idol's blessing.
cards.stakes: The pirates are closing in, and if we don't jump soon, the entire convoy will be slaughtered.
cards.board_text: We are sitting ducks out here! The navigator is having a panic attack and won't touch the console without a Gate-Cult idol to 'ward off the turbulence.' I don't care if it's rocks and wire, bring me one before those pirate ships enter firing range!

cards.need: The client specifically requested 'authentic local religious artifacts' to tie the VIP lounge together.
cards.stakes: If the room isn't perfect, they won't pay my exorbitant consulting fee.
cards.board_text: The aesthetic of this lounge is utterly ruined! The client wants a rustic, spiritual vibe, and all I have is cheap plastic junk. I need a genuine Gate-Cult idol, worn smooth by hands, to act as the centerpiece. Hurry, the opening gala is tomorrow and my reputation is on the line!

cards.need: I left the order years ago, but I want the idol to remember my friends who stayed behind.
cards.stakes: It's the only connection I have left to a community I still miss.
cards.board_text: I walked away from the gates a long time ago. The chanting, the fasting... it wasn't for me. But I miss the quiet moments. Bring me a small idol. I don't worship anymore, but I just want something to hold when the silence on this station gets too loud.

cards.need: I bet my entire allowance that I could crack a military-grade encrypted core in under an hour.
cards.stakes: If I don't produce a cracked core by tonight, my friends will ban me from the local arcade.
cards.board_text: Okay, I might have exaggerated my hacking skills. I told the local crew I crack encrypted cores for breakfast, and now they want proof. Just bring me one, any locked core with valuable data! I downloaded a brute-force script that is guaranteed to work, I just need the hardware before they realize I'm a fraud.

cards.need: Our atmospheric scrubbers failed, and these engineered crops are the only way to re-oxygenate the station.
cards.stakes: The entire population will choke to death on carbon dioxide within a week.
cards.board_text: Red alert on the ring hab. The scrubbers are dead, and our air is getting thinner by the hour. We need a hydroponic seed vault loaded with fast-growing algae and oxygenators. Bring them now, or you'll be delivering to a tomb.

cards.need: My true-crime channel is bleeding viewers, and unboxing a sealed evidence tube live on the feed will get my ratings back up.
cards.stakes: If I don't get a viral hit tonight, my sponsors will pull their funding.
cards.board_text: Hey fans, I need your help! My stream numbers are tanking. Nothing boosts engagement like a live unboxing, and I want to open a genuine sealed evidence tube right in front of the camera. I don't care what tribunal it was meant for, I just need that tamper tape intact when you hand it over. Bring it in, and I'll give you a shoutout on the cast!

cards.need: I need to study an intact sealed evidence tube to prove my old department's tamper tape is defective, clearing my name.
cards.stakes: It's the only way to get my pension restored before I'm evicted from my hab.
cards.board_text: They fired me for 'mishandling' evidence, but I know the official tamper tape degrades in high humidity! I just need a genuine sealed evidence tube, straight off the black market or found in a wreck, with the seals intact. If I can analyze the adhesive failure, I can clear my name and get my life back.
